root_cause.text: Increasing `CT_PTP_NUM` from 1 to 4 without updating `ct_vm_map()` to utilize the additional PTP pages causes the function to access beyond the single allocated PTP page, leading to an out-of-bounds page fault.

On AMD64 systems, a single PTP covers 512 PTEs (2M). When aggregate memory allocations exceed this limit, ct_vm_map() tries to access beyond the allocated space and causes a page fault."
